entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Thank you for inviting me—although,[n]I admit I feel a bit like I'm intruding...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There's no need for modesty. After all[n]we've been through, there are no[n]strangers here.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah! You really helped [fName] out,[n]too.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: In that case, I'll accept your offer.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yo, I really can't stop starin' at that thing[n]you're wearing.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Heh... So it's caught your eye as well.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It happened to catch mine while I was[n]strolling through the city.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I bought it for myself as a reward[n]for the end of the year.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What do you think? About the scarf.
It looks great on you.
It's unique.
I prefer a knitted long scarf.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Thank you. Your compliment is music[n]to my ears.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I don't think anyone other than you[n]could pull it off, Kitagawa-senpai.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Oho... You've recognized its unique[n]beauty as well!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'd say it's a little TOO unique.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I suppose the difference is whether[n]you place importance on functionality[n]or aesthetics.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, whichever you pick, just make[n]sure you don't catch a cold...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: This fashion chat is fine and all, but[n]if you don't dig into that soba soon,[n]it's gonna get soggy on you.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah, yes. My apologies.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Thank you for the food.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's chow time!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Mmm! So good!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Sakura-san, you made these noodles[n]yourself, right?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: They're amazing! You could open[n]a soba restaurant!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Aw, thanks.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I made a little too much, so if anyone[n]wants a refill—

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Seconds please!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How fast do you eat!?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You eat a lot more than I'd assumed[n]you do, Yoshizawa-san.
Her stomach's bottomless.
Well, she is an athlete.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Seriously?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: While being that thin!?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...I don't know if that fully explains[n]what's happening here.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: [lName]-senpai, don't kid them[n]so much.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: My appetite's totally normal.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: Breaking news on our top story...

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: After nearly two weeks of silence, the[n]Prosecutor's Office is planning to move[n]forward with the biggest case of the year.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: They have announced that they will move[n]forward in the charging of Representative[n]Shido for his confessed crimes.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's finally happening...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I was planning on telling all of you[n]about this a little later. This case is all[n]thanks to a certain man's testimony.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But, I can at least share this one piece[n]of good news with you.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: And that would be...?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: The woman involved in [lName]-kun's[n]false charge case has finally come forward[n]and provided her testimony.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I can't say for certain yet...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But his criminal record may very well[n]be overturned.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That's wonderful!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Congratulations, Senpai!

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Of course, this is highly confidential,[n]got it?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What great news, [fName].

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Looks like we really will be having[n]a happy new year.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This is incredible! It's an actual, real-life[n]good ending!

entries.speaker: TV Commercial
entries.en: And after that: the two-hour New Year's[n]special of "Tokyo Vice"!

entries.speaker: TV Commercial
entries.en: A thrilling tale jam-packed with some[n]of the network's most famous faces!

entries.speaker: Handsome Actor
entries.en: I'll never give up...!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I've been seeing this guy on TV[n]all the time lately.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh yeah, he's a model-turned-actor.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: With a figure like that, I can see how[n]he's gotten so popular.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, he's popular, eh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If I were more like that human, maybe[n]Lady Ann would...

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: The year is winding down to its final[n]moments—let's take a look at how people[n]are spending it, all across the country.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Now that I'm thinkin' about it, a helluva[n]lot sure did happen this year.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Right? It's like, how many years of our[n]lives did we actually live through this[n]year?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I doubt we'll experience anything even[n]similar to it for quite some time.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Well, this is just from my point of view,[n]but I really hope that's the case.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Then I guess starting next year, we'll[n]just be good boys and girls at school.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If that's the case, then I assume you'll[n]be able to handle your summer break[n]homework on your own—right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Please don't go there, Senpai...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So much has happened over the past[n]twelve months...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But in the end, we got to spend it[n]together like this. I wanna believe[n]that this was a great year for us.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yeah.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I don't have any proof, but I feel like[n]next year's gonna be even better for us.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I feel the exact same way! How strange...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well, that's only natural, considering[n]how pleased we are with our[n]end-of-year celebration.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: Young people have been gathering in[n]Shibuya all day for the big countdown[n]at midnight, and this crowd is...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I really don't want to get going, but[n]it seems like it's time.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: See ya next year, right?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Next year...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sojiro! Osechi time! Get those New[n]Year's dishes ready, chop chop! And[n]don't forget the black beans!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Yeah, yeah, I hear ya. If I start prepping[n]the beans now, they'll be ready by[n]the morning.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't worry about the food, you just[n]go have a good night's sleep.
